controlled.label: rollback4x-enemy-index-deep8-cpu4-01
controlled.scope: Three sequential worlds in one throttled renderer; manual native ticks. Correctness and recovery call pressure, not real RTC, native rAF presentation cadence or game FPS.
gates: 1800 logical frames and confirmed endpoint per peer

releaseSeries.scope: Same frozen harness/helper, build flags and deterministic frame input tape. Actual correction depth and host activity remain observed variables; ABBA ordering cannot eliminate host or network variance.

inputResponseFollowup.label: rollback4x-enemy-index-burst-response-01
inputResponseFollowup.condition: After candidate correctness gates pass. Same CPU, headed and diagnostic controls as the release series.
inputResponseFollowup.scope: Independent input intent completeness plus observed capture/presentation latency; retain short held-mask misses and include startup/tail.

primary: Continuous new-state rate and p50/p95/p99/max intervals including terminal closure
C++ callback elapsed work distribution, correction and resimulation counts
Network gap and pacing together with host activity
Independent response cohort including missing captures
notAcceptance: Full trace or anomaly collector success
No eligible 250 ms episode in a finite sample
A single improvement under changing host load
Manual controlled-tick throughput treated as rAF FPS
interpretation.failures: Retain all labels and failures. A correctness regression blocks candidate adoption and is investigated before continuing dependent performance gates; infrastructure failures are recorded with any explicit protocol revision. No silent reruns or discarded noisy samples.

operational.heavyWork: All builds, browser runs, performance and test commands serialized by root; read-only offline review may overlap.
operational.repository: Local reviewable commits only; no push, merge, deploy, canonical edits or unrelated process termination.

metrics.progress: F = native PredictionFrontier. First crossings define one contiguous [s,e) body; closed Hz and counters use F[e]-F[s] and t[e]-t[s]. Captures never substitute for completed progress.
metrics.terminalGaps: Primary new-state distributions are window.formalWithEndBoundary.newStates, including terminal closure. RAF and sampledAt clocks stay distinct. No physical scanout inference.
metrics.callbackWork: C++ callback elapsed work for all original body callbacks, including the start callback. Endpoint callback cost is tail. It is not observer JavaScript duration or GPU completion.
metrics.callbackPartition: Mutually exclusive body callback categories use adjacent native F/correction/resimulation deltas. First body callback is unknown; partition count/cost conservation is checked. All-body percentiles include no-frontier callbacks and are not game-tick costs.
metrics.phases: SessionPhase values are retained without filtering; they are not internal MatchScene values.
metrics.quantiles: Sorted values at floor(n*p), matching the frozen helper. Empty or unavailable metrics remain null, not zero.
metrics.failures: All discovered report/failure artifacts for every declared label are retained. Multiple attempts block a clean four-run comparison. results and partial remain separate.
metrics.comparability: Frozen identities, exact B/E Wasm, same helper/parameters/browser/renderer, deterministic per-side tape prefix, all 15 confirmed hashes and complete continuous windows are required. Host load never filters samples.

cpuThrottle.scope: openProbe and after-open counters precede CPU throttling; subsequent netplay setup and first game callback use the configured per-side rates.

headedLaunch.scope: Window-mode environment control, not a production code change; proxy, input, audio/context, CPU setup, and native GPU arguments are unchanged.

inputDelayEvidence.scope: D=0 is declared by the plan and pinned binary identity; this harness does not separately export inputDelayFrames as a runtime parameter.

summaryMethod.primary: summary: continuous first-cross frontier window; see each window for completeness, terminal closure and all startup/tail costs
summaryMethod.legacy: legacySummary: original next/cursor frame-filtered calculation, retained verbatim; may splice non-adjacent samples after rollback

reports.primarySnapshotRule: Use results when present; otherwise partial. Later partial is retained separately, never spliced into or substituted for results.

results.renderer: ANGLE (Intel, Intel(R) UHD Graphics (0x0000A78B) Direct3D11 vs_5_0 ps_5_0, D3D11)
